title: The service comes due at whichever trigger arrives first
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  2. A schedule open in the editor with the service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open an existing schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the blank service form.
  5. Set more than one trigger on the service (e.g. calendar plus mileage).
custom_steps: 1. Read the line beneath the triggers block heading.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The triggers block states, in one plain line beneath its heading, that the service comes due at whichever trigger arrives first; there is no "or" between the triggers and no warning panel.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10559 (S2, Add a routine service to a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S2 (unchanged requirements); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
